create_observation_from_game: create an observation object from a pyspiel game using make_observation with optional imperfect_information_observation_type and params
set_observation_from_state: set an observation from a game state and player using observation.set_from(state, player)
get_observation_string: get a human-readable string representation of an observation using observation.string_from(state, player)
compress_and_decompress_observation: compress an observation to a serialized form and decompress it back using compress and decompress methods
create_public_info_observer: create an IIGObserverForPublicInfoGame observer that returns state history string for public information games
